title: 9S4P 电池净充电 16 A 上限模型验证
purpose: 16A是电池净充电允许上界，不是各温度必须交付的电流下限。把支路温度/均流、电流测量误差、正常CCL源端动态和禁止充电时母线剩余能量约束纳入可执行参考算法；这是参数模型，不是固件、硬件或整车验收。

pack.temperature_rate_policy_note: 参考算法只在EVE规格书最大充电测试温度25C及通用试验环境25±2C内把4A/cell作为模型上限；无温度-电流曲线时，温度区间不完全落入23..27C即CCL=0，不做线性插值或假定仍可4A。必须覆盖全部36颗电芯，输入为每颗温度的保守区间；算法使用全包最冷下界min(T_i,low)和最暖上界max(T_i,high)，要求下界≥23C且上界≤27C，并拒绝缺失、非数、反向或过期区间。当前三个代表区NTC并未证明覆盖36颗电芯，故实际资格门禁仍为false。
pack.cell_current_rating_temperature_note: EVE 30P charge operating range is not a flat 4A-per-cell rating; the 4A maximum-charge test is at 25C. No verified current-versus-temperature curve is in the project evidence.
pack.full_rate_outside_test_window_policy: CCL=0 pending a manufacturer charge-current-versus-temperature curve or validated pack qualification; 5..40C is only the project's temperature-window candidate, not proof that 4A/cell is allowed throughout it.
pack.alpha_definition: 最大单支路电流 / pack净充电电流；均流上界工程假设 alpha<=1/3，仅用于参数化候选，不是已测事实或电芯厂家参数。
pack.alpha_design_assumption_rationale: 临时工程假设将最重支路设为总电流的1/3，即理想四等分1/4的1.33倍（相对理想均流允许约33.3%支路偏差）。该比例无厂家依据、无实测，必须由各并联支路电流台架测试或可追溯阻抗/温度分析验证；未验证时不可作为16A认证依据。
pack.alpha_unvalidated_fallback_note: 并联支路份额未验证时，按最坏情况把全部净充电电流分配到一支路，避免把alpha=1/3假设误当安全保证。该回退仅在已资格证明四个并联支路充电电流同向、无反向支路/循环电流时成立；资格缺失则算法CCL=0。若未来验证alpha，应证明其覆盖最大支路充电电流及循环电流影响。当前无此实物资格。

shunt.sense_path_underread_note: 10uΩ is an unqualified one-sided sensitivity allowance (2% of nominal); it is not a measured layout/pad value and is not included in the resistor manufacturer's ±1%.

software_current_gain_scale_scenarios.name: nominal_or_board_calibrated_scale
software_current_gain_scale_scenarios.evidence_status: candidate only; no firmware/config readback or four-wire pack-current calibration found in repository

software_current_gain_scale_scenarios.name: TRM_default_constant_vs_nominal_calculation_sensitivity
software_current_gain_scale_scenarios.evidence_status: sensitivity only: TRM data-memory table gives 7.4768/Rsense while its calculation section gives nominal 7.5684/Rsense; resolve the exact programmed/read-back value before release

normal_ccl_model.source_current_overshoot_design_budget_s: design acceptance limit only; not measured, not guaranteed by current sources, and not the OCC threshold
normal_ccl_model.source_current_overshoot_definition: I_os = total positive pack-current overshoot after an aggregate CCL change. Design acceptance is max(0,dI/dt)*local_response_delay + additional_peak_overshoot <= 1.0A across concurrent sources. The 1.0A bound is a conservative design budget to be verified at the local source loops; current source slew, local delay, and waveform are unknown.
assumed_underread_error_components: CC INL absolute maximum 22.3 LSB (TI says characterized)
CC offset ±1 LSB (uncalibrated datasheet value, conservative after any unverified board calibration)
CC post-calibration drift 0.03 LSB/C times 35C from 25C to 60C
DNL 1 LSB engineering assumption; TI datasheet lists only ±0.1 LSB typical and TI FAQ recommends 1 LSB for a conservative calculation
CC2 code stability ±1 LSB at 3sigma used only as an explicit engineering reserve, not a hard maximum

occ_protection.normal_operation_margin_note: 0.5A is an explicit engineering planning margin below the OCC early-action corner, not a BQ specification or verified protection coordination margin.
occ_protection.occ_shunt_temperature_corner_note: Use RSHUNT ±1% and ±50ppm/C worst absolute TCR over 25C calibration to 75C candidate thermal limit for both early and late OCC current corners; 75C itself remains an unverified thermal design limit.
occ_protection.note: Design candidate only; actual write/readback is unverified. Comparator trip-and-delay protection may turn off CHG FET if configured, not a current regulator, not a 16A upper-bound guarantee, and not an energy sink for sources still feeding the public bus. Normal CCL peak planning is kept 0.5A below the candidate early-action corner as an explicit engineering margin, not a BQ specification or verified coordination margin.

notes: CCL=0 case models battery charging prohibited; only bus injection from 30W solar plus the parameterized regen power remains.
Supercap is an optional absorber behind the bidirectional DC/DC. The model does not add it to bus capacitance and hypothetical ratings are not installed/validated hardware.
Bus load is set to zero for a conservative no-load energy screen. Source delay is local source stop latency, not CAN period.

control_fault_policy.full_cell_or_near_voltage_limit: reduce CCL by cell voltage/SOC policy and taper to zero before configured cell-voltage protection; if COV fault, stop charge sources and allow configured BQ CHG-FET protection to act.
control_fault_policy.low_temperature_below_candidate_window: CCL=0; stop/inhibit source charging; if UTC protection is enabled and configured, it is a separate CHG-FET hard protection, not normal regulation.
control_fault_policy.invalid_stale_sensor_or_config: CCL=0; local sources ramp/disable with a verified local response. If the source fails, BQ OCC/COV/UTC protections are backup hard trips if enabled/read back. Route unabsorbed regen to a verified supercap DC/DC sink or command zero regen and use vehicle braking; do not assume supercap acceptance.
control_fault_policy.recovery: require valid cell/current/temp/configuration readback, no active charge protection, cell voltage/SOC headroom, source capability freshness, and valid temperature continuously for 3s, then ramp source back up under the newly recomputed CCL.
